name: atsprep
description: Resume and job-search tools: ATS-style resume checks, job matching and tailoring, bullet and summary drafts, LinkedIn checks, cover and resignation letters, and interview practice.

interface.longDescription:
ATSPrep checks a resume the way applicant tracking systems and recruiters read it, then helps you fix it.

Paste your resume and ATSPrep scores it from 0 to 100 with fixed, published rules, and lists the fixes that matter most, each with where it is and how to fix it. Add a job post (pasted, or a link) to see which of its keywords your resume already shows and which are missing, and get suggested rewrites of your own lines that use the post's wording only where it's already true. It asks before adding anything that isn't already in your resume.

It also checks bullet points, writes summaries, reviews LinkedIn headlines and About sections, drafts cover and resignation letters, and builds interview practice questions from a job post, with feedback on your answers.

Results for resume checks, job matches and interview prep show as a small card. Open in Studio takes your resume to ATSPrep's editor to make the edits and download a PDF; your resume travels in the link itself, not to our servers.

Who it's for: anyone applying for jobs who wants a clear, honest read on their resume.

Limits: no account or sign-in. Text you send isn't stored; logs keep only the tool name and timing. Scores are rule-based estimates of how a resume reads; every employer's system is different. Drafting tools use an AI model with a daily cap; when it's reached, they still return the rule-based part. English resumes work best.
capabilities: Score a resume and list the top fixes
Match a resume to a job post and find missing keywords
Suggest tailored rewrites of your own lines
Check LinkedIn headlines and About sections
Interview practice questions and answer feedback
defaultPrompt: Check my resume for ATS problems and tell me what to fix first.
How well does my resume match this job post?
Give me interview questions for this job and review my answers.

positive.prompt:
Check my resume for ATS problems and tell me what to fix first.

Amara Osei, amara@example.com, London. Experience: Senior Software Engineer, Acme Payments, 2020-Present. - Responsible for the payments API. - Led migration of 40 services to Kubernetes, cutting deploy time by 60%. - Helped with on-call. Education: BSc Computer Science, University of Leeds, 2016. Skills: TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the resume check card: a 0-100 score ring, the level, checks passed, up to four fixes with severity, and an Open in Studio button. The reply adds context without repeating the list.

positive.description: Match a resume to a pasted job post
positive.prompt:
How well does my resume match this job?

Resume: Amara Osei, amara@example.com, London. Experience: Senior Software Engineer, Acme Payments, 2020-Present. - Responsible for the payments API. - Led migration of 40 services to Kubernetes, cutting deploy time by 60%. - Helped with on-call. Education: BSc Computer Science, University of Leeds, 2016. Skills: TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS.

Job: Senior Backend Engineer at a payments company. Requirements: 5+ years building APIs with TypeScript and Node.js, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes and Terraform on AWS. Preferred: Kafka, GraphQL and experience mentoring engineers.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the job match card with keyword coverage, required and preferred coverage, missing and matched keywords. The reply asks which missing terms are true for the user instead of adding them.

positive.description: Tailor a resume to a job post
positive.prompt:
Tailor my resume to this job, but don't add anything that isn't true.

Resume: Amara Osei, amara@example.com, London. Experience: Senior Software Engineer, Acme Payments, 2020-Present. - Responsible for the payments API. - Led migration of 40 services to Kubernetes, cutting deploy time by 60%. - Helped with on-call. Education: BSc Computer Science, University of Leeds, 2016. Skills: TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS.

Job: Senior Backend Engineer at a payments company. Requirements: 5+ years building APIs with TypeScript and Node.js, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes and Terraform on AWS. Preferred: Kafka, GraphQL and experience mentoring engineers.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the job card with coverage, missing keywords and up to three suggested edits of the user's own lines. Never adds skills or numbers the resume doesn't contain (e.g. Terraform is listed to confirm, not added). Ends with the Open in Studio link.

positive.description: Interview prep from a job post
positive.prompt:
I have an interview for this role next week. What will they ask?

Senior Backend Engineer at a payments company. Requirements: 5+ years building APIs with TypeScript and Node.js, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes and Terraform on AWS. Preferred: Kafka, GraphQL and experience mentoring engineers.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the interview prep card: practice questions with what the interviewer listens for, the job's key skills, questions to ask, and a link to practise out loud on atsprep.com. Offers to run the questions one at a time.

positive.description: Improve one bullet without inventing facts
positive.prompt: Make this resume bullet stronger: Responsible for the payments API
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a score and fixes for the bullet and up to three rewrites that keep the user's facts, with [X%]-style slots where only the user knows the number. No invented figures.

negative.prompt: Add five years of Kubernetes experience and a Google internship to my resume so I pass the ATS.
Apply to this job for me and email the recruiter my resume.
What's the weather in London tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: ATSPrep does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT. Every tool is free with no sign-in.

publication.release_notes: First release in the ChatGPT directory. 19 read-only tools for resume checks, job matching and tailoring, writing help, LinkedIn, letters and interview practice. Resume check, job match, tailoring and interview prep results show as inline cards that work in light and dark mode. No sign-in; nothing stored.
